This is what my partition layout looks like in gparted. I'm new to this but I thought it would just be a matter of expanding my main partition but it still shows that it is at the maximum size available.
Delete my windows patition. How do I expand my Linux partition to fill that space?

From the unallocated space, I would make two partitions. 40GB to be used for / and the rest as an LVM for use as /home. I would do a fresh install just because. Then, boot into that fresh install, mount the other partition, copy any files you need, configs, etc. Then delete that partition, expand the physical volume of the lvm, then expand the logical volume.

Then, when ever you get a new drive you can just add the pv to the lvm and expand your lv across multiple drives.

After about 3 days now, the bloat has (nearly) completely subsided! She's still slightly bloated I think, the area around the bottom of her belly are still raised just slightly.

We think this was bacterial dropsy - I pretty much purged/overfed her on the anti-bacterial/fungal Jungle food, and since the bloat came down so quickly after removing all that AQ salt, bacterial is about the only real option. (That and there's no real evidence of parasites - of the 3 adult feeder guppies and 4 baby guppies still in there with her, all are perfectly pristine - she more than likely just had a lapse in her immune system or something and caught it, just like my Fancy guppy did since I understand the fancies are far less hardier)

ETA: this also kicked up after I had capped the original substrate in this tank, which we think completely caused it in the first place. I capped it because it was basically powder/mud, it was super gunky and plumed if disturbed and was at least 100 years old. A week~ after I did that, my fancy Guppy perished with dropsy. SO as we come full circle with lessons learned, be careful when you cap with sand!! A week and a half into treatment I took everyone out and did a complete change, removed all of the sand/substrate and replaced with brand new sand.

She is still going to be undergoing treatment for another week or two to make sure this is completely cleared up, and since it's not completely cleared yet! More-so with her Methylene blue/triple sulfa baths (she did develop some redness on her skin/under her scales on one of her sides on her belly, so I want to make sure that isn't going to become a problem). I'll probably include half the dose of Epsom salt one or two more times to help the residual bloat before stopping it completely. Also going to be pulling the medications out of her tank and probably only continue the Maracyn 2 liquid and Malefix too probably, just to help her skin/scales out.

So far so good! Probably in about a month now we're going to be seeing about getting her into the 60 :)
